description: This file provides RDKB platform-specific API wrappers for logging, PSM (Parameter Storage Manager) get/set operations, and partner ID retrieval, primarily interfacing with the CCSP library.

methods.name: CcspTraceEmergencyRdkb
methods.description: Logs an emergency level message using CCSP trace.

methods.name: CcspTraceAlertRdkb
methods.description: Logs an alert level message using CCSP trace.

methods.name: CcspTraceCriticalRdkb
methods.description: Logs a critical level message using CCSP trace.

methods.name: CcspTraceErrorRdkb
methods.description: Logs an error level message using CCSP trace.

methods.name: CcspTraceWarningRdkb
methods.description: Logs a warning level message using CCSP trace.

methods.name: CcspTraceNoticeRdkb
methods.description: Logs a notice level message using CCSP trace.

methods.name: CcspTraceInfoRdkb
methods.description: Logs an info level message using CCSP trace.

methods.name: CcspTraceDebugRdkb
methods.description: Logs a debug level message using CCSP trace.

methods.name: psm_get_value_Rdkb
methods.description: Retrieves a value from PSM with retries, handling success and error cases.

methods.name: psm_set_value_Rdkb
methods.description: Sets a value in PSM and logs the operation result.

methods.name: get_partner_id_Rdkb
methods.description: Retrieves partner ID, returning success or error.
